item.title: Brazil begins exploring retaliatory options to new US tariffs
item.description: Brazil has not yet decided whether it will proceed with retaliatory measures, but commits to defending its position.

item.title: Mali says 82 soldiers captured by armed groups have been freed
item.description: Malian army says the soldiers were held prisoner by Tuareg and al-Qaeda-linked armed groups in the northern region.

item.title: Oil slick from tanker carrying sanctioned Russian crude reaches Oman
item.description: An oil slick from the tanker the Caroline Bezengi has reached Oman’s coastline weeks after the vessel ran aground.

item.title: Why Osun’s election matters for Nigeria’s 2027 vote
item.description: The result could offer an early signal of shifting alliances and voter sentiment before the presidential race.

item.description: UN rights office and Palestine Foreign Ministry call days-long Israeli settler siege in Qusra 'criminal' and 'inhumane'.

item.title: Could Trump actually run for a third term as president?
item.description: Donald Trump says the law stopping him from seeking a third presidential term is ‘very strong’.

item.title: Bodycam captures lightning striking metres from US police officers
item.description: Bodycam video captured the moment lightning struck just metres from South Dakota Highway Patrol officers.

item.title: Talks between government and opposition mark a new chapter for Venezuela
item.description: The government of Delcy Rodriguez held its first talks with part of Venezuela's opposition. But what will they achieve?

item.title: AI escapes confinement
item.description: Over the course of two weeks, AI companies said that some of their AI models managed to hack systems.

item.title: Colombia’s rescuers search rubble as hope fades on finding survivors

item.title: UAE accuses Iran of attacks on two ADNOC vessels in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: No injuries were reported in the attack, which the UAE called 'piracy' and a threat to global energy security.

item.title: Yemen faces highest risk of returning to war since 2022 truce, UN warns
item.description: Civilian and military casualties have been reported as fighting has flared across Yemeni front lines in recent days.

item.title: Iran war live: US eyes indefinite Iran naval blockade

item.description: The economy dominates voter concerns in the southern African country.

item.title: Kennedy Center votes to restore Trump’s name to venue, close for two years
item.description: Trustees condemn Kennedy Center’s move to re-add Trump’s name and shut down for extensive renovations.

item.description: At least six homes were set alight by an extensive wildfire in Stourbridge
